AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/libs/toolbar/qml/Toolbar.qml
    IMPORT common 1.0
    IMPORT dk.ingatellent.SceneAssistant 1.0
    IMPORT net.asivery.XoviMessageBroker 2.0
    TRAVERSE FocusScope > Item#toolbar > GridLayout
        LOCATE AFTER Repeater[.model=`toolbarProvider.editingTools`]
        INSERT {

ToolbarTool {
    id: aiGradeButton
    toolbar: root
    type: ToolbarTool.Type.FoldoutButton
    iconSource: "qrc:/ark/icons/grid"
    enabled: true
    visible: root.expanded
    onPressed: root._select(aiGradeButton)

    foldoutContent: ColumnLayout {
        spacing: 0

        ArkControls.FoldoutItem {
            label: "Grade page"
            iconSource: "qrc:/ark/icons/grid"
            antialiasing: root.antialiasing
            focusPolicy: Qt.NoFocus
            Layout.fillWidth: true
            onClicked: {
                aiBridgeHost.gradeReq = "one " + String(Date.now());
                aiBridgeHost.submit([
                    { pts: [[700, 80], [760, 80]] },
                    { pts: [[700, 95], [760, 95]] }
                ]);
                root._select(aiGradeButton);
            }
        }

        ArkControls.FoldoutItem {
            label: "Fill day log"
            iconSource: "qrc:/ark/icons/grid"
            antialiasing: root.antialiasing
            focusPolicy: Qt.NoFocus
            Layout.fillWidth: true
            onClicked: {
                aiBridgeHost.gradeReq = "eval " + String(Date.now());
                aiBridgeHost.submit([
                    { pts: [[700, 80], [760, 80]] }
                ]);
                root._select(aiGradeButton);
            }
        }

        ArkControls.FoldoutItem {
            label: "Fill after-action form"
            iconSource: "qrc:/ark/icons/grid"
            antialiasing: root.antialiasing
            focusPolicy: Qt.NoFocus
            Layout.fillWidth: true
            onClicked: {
                aiBridgeHost.gradeReq = "form " + String(Date.now());
                aiBridgeHost.submit([
                    { pts: [[700, 80], [760, 80]] }
                ]);
                root._select(aiGradeButton);
            }
        }

        RowLayout {
            Layout.fillWidth: true
            spacing: 0

            ArkControls.FoldoutItem {
                label: "\u2212"
                iconSource: "qrc:/ark/icons/grid"
                antialiasing: root.antialiasing
                focusPolicy: Qt.NoFocus
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                onClicked: { if (aiBridgeHost.pageCount > 2) aiBridgeHost.pageCount = aiBridgeHost.pageCount - 1; }
            }

            ArkControls.FoldoutItem {
                label: "Go: " + aiBridgeHost.pageCount + " pages"
                iconSource: "qrc:/ark/icons/grid"
                antialiasing: root.antialiasing
                focusPolicy: Qt.NoFocus
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                onClicked: {
                    aiBridgeHost.gradeReq = "n:" + aiBridgeHost.pageCount + " " + String(Date.now());
                    aiBridgeHost.submit([
                        { pts: [[700, 80], [760, 80]] },
                        { pts: [[700, 95], [760, 95]] },
                        { pts: [[700, 110], [760, 110]] }
                    ]);
                    root._select(aiGradeButton);
                }
            }

            ArkControls.FoldoutItem {
                label: "+"
                iconSource: "qrc:/ark/icons/grid"
                antialiasing: root.antialiasing
                focusPolicy: Qt.NoFocus
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                onClicked: { if (aiBridgeHost.pageCount < 30) aiBridgeHost.pageCount = aiBridgeHost.pageCount + 1; }
            }
        }

        ArkControls.FoldoutItem {
            label: "Grade all pages"
            iconSource: "qrc:/ark/icons/grid"
            antialiasing: root.antialiasing
            focusPolicy: Qt.NoFocus
            Layout.fillWidth: true
            onClicked: {
                aiBridgeHost.gradeReq = "all " + String(Date.now());
                aiBridgeHost.submit([
                    { pts: [[700, 80], [760, 80]] },
                    { pts: [[700, 95], [760, 95]] },
                    { pts: [[700, 110], [760, 110]] }
                ]);
                root._select(aiGradeButton);
            }
        }
    }
}

Item {
    id: aiBridgeHost
    visible: false

    property bool vtableReady: false
    property string gradeReq: ""
    property int pageCount: 3
    property var job: null
    property string jobState: "IDLE"
    property string jobResult: ""
    property int ticks: 0
    property int aiLayer: -1
    property int userLayer: -1
    property int drawn: 0

    function ensureReady() {
        if (!aiBridgeHost.vtableReady) {
            aiBridgeHost.vtableReady = SceneAssistant.ensureVtable(sceneController);
        }
        return aiBridgeHost.vtableReady;
    }

    function findAiLayer() {
        for (var i = 0; i < sceneController.layerCount; ++i) {
            if (sceneController.layerName(i) === "AI Feedback") return i;
        }
        return -1;
    }

    function readFileText(path) {
        var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
        xhr.open("GET", "file://" + path, false);
        xhr.send();
        return xhr.responseText;
    }

    function fail(msg) {
        aiBridgeHost.jobResult = "ERR " + msg;
        aiBridgeHost.jobState = "IDLE";
        aiBridgeHost.job = null;
        stepTimer.stop();
        if (aiBridgeHost.userLayer >= 0) sceneController.setCurrentLayer(aiBridgeHost.userLayer);
    }

    property string itemsPath: ""
    property real itemsCx: 0
    property real itemsCy: 0

    function submitItems(path, cx, cy) {
        if (!sceneController) return "ERR noscene";
        if (aiBridgeHost.jobState !== "IDLE") return "ERR busy " + aiBridgeHost.jobState;
        aiBridgeHost.userLayer = sceneController.currentLayer;
        aiBridgeHost.aiLayer = aiBridgeHost.findAiLayer();
        if (aiBridgeHost.aiLayer < 0 && sceneController.layerCount >= 5) return "ERR maxlayers";
        aiBridgeHost.itemsPath = path;
        aiBridgeHost.itemsCx = cx;
        aiBridgeHost.itemsCy = cy;
        aiBridgeHost.job = null;
        aiBridgeHost.drawn = 0;
        aiBridgeHost.ticks = 0;
        aiBridgeHost.jobResult = "";
        aiBridgeHost.jobState = (aiBridgeHost.aiLayer >= 0) ? "SWITCH" : "ADD";
        stepTimer.start();
        return "QUEUED";
    }

    function submit(lines) {
        if (!sceneController) return "ERR noscene";
        if (aiBridgeHost.jobState !== "IDLE") return "ERR busy " + aiBridgeHost.jobState;
        if (!aiBridgeHost.ensureReady()) return "ERR vtable";
        aiBridgeHost.userLayer = sceneController.currentLayer;
        aiBridgeHost.aiLayer = aiBridgeHost.findAiLayer();
        if (aiBridgeHost.aiLayer < 0 && sceneController.layerCount >= 5) return "ERR maxlayers";
        aiBridgeHost.job = lines;
        aiBridgeHost.itemsPath = "";
        aiBridgeHost.drawn = 0;
        aiBridgeHost.ticks = 0;
        aiBridgeHost.jobResult = "";
        aiBridgeHost.jobState = (aiBridgeHost.aiLayer >= 0) ? "SWITCH" : "ADD";
        stepTimer.start();
        return "QUEUED";
    }

    Timer {
        id: stepTimer
        interval: 60
        repeat: true
        running: false

        // one mutation per event-loop turn; verify the previous step before the next.
        onTriggered: {
            try {
                if (!sceneController) { aiBridgeHost.fail("scene lost"); return; }
                aiBridgeHost.ticks++;
                if (aiBridgeHost.ticks > 80) { aiBridgeHost.fail("timeout in " + aiBridgeHost.jobState); return; }
                var s = aiBridgeHost.jobState;

                if (s === "ADD") {
                    aiBridgeHost.aiLayer = sceneController.layerCount;   // index the new layer will get
                    sceneController.addLayer();
                    aiBridgeHost.jobState = "NAME";
                    return;
                }
                if (s === "NAME") {
                    if (sceneController.layerCount !== aiBridgeHost.aiLayer + 1) return; // add not committed yet
                    sceneController.setLayerName(aiBridgeHost.aiLayer, "AI Feedback");
                    aiBridgeHost.jobState = "NAMED";
                    return;
                }
                if (s === "NAMED") {
                    if (sceneController.layerName(aiBridgeHost.aiLayer) !== "AI Feedback") return;
                    aiBridgeHost.jobState = "SWITCH";
                    return;
                }
                if (s === "SWITCH") {
                    sceneController.setCurrentLayer(aiBridgeHost.aiLayer);
                    aiBridgeHost.jobState = "DRAW";
                    return;
                }
                if (s === "DRAW") {
                    if (sceneController.currentLayer !== aiBridgeHost.aiLayer) return; // switch not committed yet
                    if (aiBridgeHost.itemsPath !== "") {
                        var its = SceneAssistant.loadSceneItems(aiBridgeHost.itemsPath, sceneController);
                        aiBridgeHost.itemsPath = "";
                        if (!its || its.length === 0) { aiBridgeHost.fail("no items loaded"); return; }
                        var ctr = Qt.point(aiBridgeHost.itemsCx, aiBridgeHost.itemsCy);
                        var shape = "";
                        var errs = [];
                        try {
                            sceneController.cloneAddAndSelectItems(
                                sceneController.currentLayer, its, 1 / sceneView.defaultScale, ctr);
                            shape = "layer,items,scale,center";
                        } catch (e1) { errs.push("A:" + e1); }
                        if (shape === "") {
                            try {
                                sceneController.cloneAddAndSelectItems(its, 1 / sceneView.defaultScale, ctr);
                                shape = "items,scale,center";
                            } catch (e2) { errs.push("B:" + e2); }
                        }
                        if (shape === "") {
                            try {
                                sceneController.cloneAddAndSelectItems(sceneController.currentLayer, its, ctr);
                                shape = "layer,items,center";
                            } catch (e3) { errs.push("C:" + e3); }
                        }
                        if (shape === "") {
                            try {
                                sceneController.cloneAddAndSelectItems(its, ctr);
                                shape = "items,center";
                            } catch (e4) { errs.push("D:" + e4); }
                        }
                        if (shape === "") { aiBridgeHost.fail("clone: " + errs.join(" | ")); return; }
                        aiBridgeHost.jobResult = "shape=" + shape;
                        sceneController.clearSelectedItems();
                        sceneView.tileManager.reload();
                        var nIts = its.length;
                        aiBridgeHost.drawn = (typeof nIts === "number") ? nIts : 1;
                        sceneController.setCurrentLayer(aiBridgeHost.userLayer);
                        aiBridgeHost.jobState = "RESTORE";
                        return;
                    }
                    var lines = aiBridgeHost.job;
                    for (var j = 0; j < lines.length; ++j) {
                        var pts = lines[j].pts;
                        var col = lines[j].c;
                        var rgba = lines[j].rgba;
                        for (var k = 0; k + 1 < pts.length; ++k) {
                            var seg = SceneAssistant.createLine(
                                Qt.point(pts[k][0], pts[k][1]),
                                Qt.point(pts[k + 1][0], pts[k + 1][1]));
                            if (col !== undefined) {
                                try {
                                    var rec = SceneAssistant.setColorOnSceneItems([seg], col, rgba);
                                    if (rec && rec.length > 0) seg = rec[0];
                                } catch (colErr) { /* colour is best-effort; ink beats no ink */ }
                            }
                            sceneController.addDrawingLine(seg);
                            sceneView.tileManager.renderLineToTiles(seg);
                            aiBridgeHost.drawn++;
                        }
                    }
                    sceneView.tileManager.reload();
                    sceneController.setCurrentLayer(aiBridgeHost.userLayer);
                    aiBridgeHost.jobState = "RESTORE";
                    return;
                }
                if (s === "RESTORE") {
                    if (sceneController.currentLayer !== aiBridgeHost.userLayer) return;
                    aiBridgeHost.jobResult = "DONE drawn=" + aiBridgeHost.drawn + " layer=" + aiBridgeHost.aiLayer + " " + aiBridgeHost.jobResult;
                    aiBridgeHost.jobState = "IDLE";
                    aiBridgeHost.job = null;
                    stepTimer.stop();
                    return;
                }
            } catch (err) {
                aiBridgeHost.fail(String(err));
            }
        }
    }

    Connections {
        target: sceneView
        function onCompletedStroke() {
            try {
                var xr = new XMLHttpRequest();
                var prev = "";
                try {
                    xr.open("GET", "file:///home/root/rmgrade/strokes.log", false);
                    xr.send();
                    prev = xr.responseText;
                } catch (e1) {}
                if (prev.length > 100000) prev = "";
                var xw = new XMLHttpRequest();
                xw.open("PUT", "file:///home/root/rmgrade/strokes.log", false);
                xw.send(prev + Date.now() + "\n");
            } catch (e2) {}
        }
    }

    XoviMessageBroker {
        id: aiBroker
        listeningFor: ["aiPing", "aiPoll", "aiInfo", "aiStatus", "aiView", "aiV2S", "aiVis", "aiPage", "aiGoto", "aiNext", "aiFwd", "aiAdopt", "aiCross", "aiItems", "aiLines"]

        function onSignalReceived(sgn, message) {
            try {
                if (sgn === "aiPing") return "pong";

                if (sgn === "aiPoll") return aiBridgeHost.gradeReq || "none";

                if (sgn === "aiStatus") {
                    return (aiBridgeHost.jobState === "IDLE")
                        ? (aiBridgeHost.jobResult || "IDLE")
                        : aiBridgeHost.jobState;
                }

                if (sgn === "aiInfo") {
                    if (!sceneController) return "ERR noscene";
                    var names = [];
                    for (var i = 0; i < sceneController.layerCount; ++i) {
                        names.push(sceneController.layerName(i));
                    }
                    return JSON.stringify({
                        layerCount: sceneController.layerCount,
                        currentLayer: sceneController.currentLayer,
                        layerNames: names,
                        pageId: String(sceneController.pageId)
                    });
                }

                if (sgn === "aiV2S") {
                    if (!sceneController) return "ERR noscene";
                    var vp = message.split(",");
                    var sp = sceneView.viewToScene(Qt.point(parseFloat(vp[0]), parseFloat(vp[1])));
                    return JSON.stringify({x: sp.x, y: sp.y});
                }

                if (sgn === "aiPage") {
                    if (!sceneController) return "ERR noscene";
                    return String(sceneView.page);
                }

                if (sgn === "aiGoto") {
                    if (!sceneController) return "ERR noscene";
                    try { sceneView.goToPage(parseInt(message)); return "OK goto " + message; }
                    catch (e) { return "ERR " + e; }
                }

                if (sgn === "aiNext") {
                    if (!sceneController) return "ERR noscene";
                    try {
                        sceneView.goToPage(sceneView.page + 1);
                        return "OK goToPage " + (sceneView.page + 1);
                    } catch (e1) {
                        try { sceneView.moveForward(); return "OK moveForward"; }
                        catch (e2) { return "ERR " + e1 + " | " + e2; }
                    }
                }

                if (sgn === "aiView") {
                    if (!sceneController) return "ERR noscene";
                    var out = { keys: Object.keys(sceneView) };
                    var vals = {};
                    var ks = out.keys;
                    for (var vi = 0; vi < ks.length; ++vi) {
                        var k = ks[vi];
                        if (/scale|zoom|offset|content|origin|transform|pan|viewport|page|bounds/i.test(k)) {
                            try {
                                var v = sceneView[k];
                                if (typeof v !== "function" && typeof v !== "object") vals[k] = v;
                                else if (typeof v === "object" && v !== null) vals[k] = String(v);
                            } catch (ve) {}
                        }
                    }
                    out.vals = vals;
                    try { out.tm = Object.keys(sceneView.tileManager); } catch (te) {}
                    return JSON.stringify(out);
                }

                if (sgn === "aiVis") {
                    if (!sceneController) return "ERR noscene";
                    var vli = aiBridgeHost.findAiLayer();
                    if (vli < 0) return "OK none";
                    sceneController.setLayerVisible(vli, message === "1");
                    sceneView.tileManager.reload();
                    return "OK vis " + message + " layer " + vli;
                }

                if (sgn === "aiFwd") {
                    // programmatic page-forward (the swipe path) — unlike
                    // goToPage this CAN create a new blank page at the end
                    if (!sceneController) return "ERR noscene";
                    try { sceneView.moveForward(); return "OK fwd"; }
                    catch (e) { return "ERR " + e; }
                }

                if (sgn === "aiAdopt") {
                    if (!sceneController) return "ERR noscene";
                    var ad = parseInt(message);
                    if (isNaN(ad) || ad <= 0 || ad >= sceneController.layerCount) return "ERR idx";
                    if (aiBridgeHost.findAiLayer() >= 0) return "ERR exists";
                    sceneController.setLayerName(ad, "AI Feedback");
                    return "OK adopt " + ad;
                }

                if (sgn === "aiCross") {
                    var p = message.split(",");
                    var cx = parseFloat(p[0]), cy = parseFloat(p[1]);
                    return aiBridgeHost.submit([
                        { pts: [[cx - 30, cy], [cx + 30, cy]] },
                        { pts: [[cx, cy - 30], [cx, cy + 30]] }
                    ]);
                }

                if (sgn === "aiItems") {
                    // message = "path,cx,cy" — items JSON with baked-in colors
                    if (!sceneController) return "ERR noscene";
                    if (!aiBridgeHost.ensureReady()) return "ERR vtable";
                    var ia = message.split(",");
                    return aiBridgeHost.submitItems(ia[0], parseFloat(ia[1]), parseFloat(ia[2]));
                }

                if (sgn === "aiLines") {
                    var batch = JSON.parse(aiBridgeHost.readFileText(message));
                    if (!batch.lines || batch.lines.length > 2048) return "ERR batch";
                    return aiBridgeHost.submit(batch.lines);
                }
            } catch (err) {
                return "ERR " + err;
            }
        }
    }
}

        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
